composition.density: Bimodal: browse sparse and visual-led; bag/checkout dense and text-led.
composition.detail: Full-bleed visual header; white sheet overlaps it; single left rail of content; purchase row pinned in the sheet.
composition.home: Coloured hero field (brand) carrying brand row, tagline, search pill; content sheet overlaps the field with a large top radius; one promo band; visual-first product grid; bottom tab bar.

grammar.badges: Tint-surface pill, brand text; certification uses the cert colour exactly once (detail features).
grammar.cta: One pill shape for primary actions, brand fill, white text.
grammar.numbers: Bag totals must equal the sum of line items; unit prices shown per kg everywhere.
grammar.selection: Category circles; selected = filled brand with white glyph, unselected = white with ink glyph.

imagery.role: Product visual is the largest element of every card and the detail header.
imagery.substitution: No photography available offline; SVG cut illustrations on dark boards occupy the photo slot (declared limitation).

provenance.interpreted: Composition, grammar and role assignments below are visual interpretation by the analysing model, recorded in REFERENCE_ANALYSIS.md. Font identities are NOT inferred; only roles.
provenance.measured: engine/analyze_image.py on the original file: modal hue bin 0deg, brand cluster centre #801010 (quantized), warm near-whites ~51% of pixels, sat>=0.25 = 30.35%
uncertainty: Brand hex is a cluster centre over a board that includes photography; flat UI fields in the image sit in the #7A0C10-#9E1B1E band.
Exact radii/spacing are estimated from proportions at 736px board width, not measured from source design files (none exist).

typography.uiRole: clean grotesque sans (UI text, prices semi-bold)
